_doc: HELD-OUT TOPICS for search-engine development. These topics were never used to develop, tune, test or fixture the concept-query engine (selection was mechanical: zero occurrences in tests/**, scripts/search_*.py, the search test set, the recall artefact, the recovery log, harness/lexicon.py, or any search-engine commit message -- evidence/search-acquisition-2026-09-14/02-heldout-selection.txt). They are the ONLY topics on which engine recall may be published. The mechanism (harness/heldout.py, a verify_all limb, .githooks/commit-msg) REFUSES any commit in which a held-out slug appears in a test, a fixture, a hard-coded target list, an engine source file, or a commit message after enforced_since. The only permitted artefacts are listed in allowed_paths (the measurement outputs and the topic's own data).
commit_message_rule: after enforced_since, no commit message (subject or body) may contain a held-out slug or its first-two-token short form
measurement_rule: recall is measured only by scripts/measure_heldout_recall.py against the pinned known-eligible set (pooled primary trials + eligible-declared-absent trials with PMIDs); the artefact records the engine's git blob sha; verify_all refuses if harness/acquisition.py has changed since the last published measurement
